items.problem: Legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs collides with SDK auto-generated assembly attributes → CS0579 duplicate-attribute (and CS0246) build failures.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:3172-3177 (CS0579), :3388-3393 (CS0246); 2 wasted build cycles turns 38-41. lessons.json errors_encountered[0..1].
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies AssemblyInfo.cs verbatim; SDK-style project also emits those attributes.
items.change: Added step 1b to Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: empty any copied AssemblyInfo.cs that declares [assembly: Assembly*] attributes, leaving a comment (SDK auto-generates). Cannot be ignored by the agent.
items.expected_effect: Migrated projects build without CS0579/CS0246 from legacy assembly attributes; no manual trim/empty cycles.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, 0 CS0579 'Duplicate System.Reflection.Assembly*Attribute' errors and init log reports 'Emptied legacy assembly-attribute file ...'.

items.problem: Same CS0579 also documented for the agent as a fallback when a legacy AssemblyInfo.cs slips through.
items.evidence: grep of skill found no AssemblyInfo/CS0579 coverage.
items.root_cause: No documented pattern for the SDK-style duplicate-assembly-attribute error.
items.change: Added a 'CS0579 Duplicate Assembly*Attribute (legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs)' subsection under MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' — empty the file (or GenerateAssemblyInfo=false).
items.expected_effect: If the script fix misses an edge case, the agent has the fix documented and does not trim attribute-by-attribute.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run with a stray AssemblyInfo.cs, the agent empties it in one edit rather than iterating.

items.problem: UWP App Service provider activation has no WinAppSDK equivalent (ExtendedActivationKind.AppService / IAppServiceActivatedEventArgs absent); agent burned a build cycle porting then stripping it.
items.root_cause: Activation section documents supported kinds but not the absent AppService provider path.
items.change: Added a callout in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Application Lifecycle and Activation': ExtendedActivationKind has no AppService member, IAppServiceActivatedEventArgs is unavailable, drop/host-out-of-process the provider, note GetActivatedEventArgs() is instance (GetCurrent()), and client-side AppServiceConnection still works with package identity.
items.expected_effect: Agent removes the provider activation branch immediately instead of compiling into CS0117/CS0234.
items.falsifiable_check: On a future app-service scenario, no CS0117 ExtendedActivationKind.AppService / CS0234 IAppServiceActivatedEventArgs errors appear.
